findings.message: The fast-toss capture has an apex height of 10 m. The height axis runs to 10.5 m, so the ball sits near the top of the lane. The numbers are consistent: apex time 2 s, scrubber -2 to 2 s, a = -5. The drawing cannot be judged for clipping without pixels.

The tossed ball's velocity arrow is 60 px for 5 m/s, which is 12 px per m/s. At 0.98 m/s it is 11.76 px, and at -5 m/s it is 60 px pointing down. The arrow signs and scales agree with the traces. The gate opens at the apex, and the faint outlines keep the shared starting height.

The tossed ball's acceleration arrow is 33.3 px long at 9.8 m/s². At 5 m/s² it is 17 px. This matches the 3.4 px per m/s² scale. All checkpoints match the physics: v = ±0.98 and 0 m/s, a = -g, and the dropped ball matches the tossed ball after release. The description and title are consistent with the story, and no scene draws the story as text.
